providers.name: California Pet Grooming Mobile
providers.description: Advertises mobile dog grooming and explicitly lists Mountain House, Tracy, Lathrop and Manteca. The official website publishes this contact number and links to an appointment-request system. Confirm your service address, dog requirements, quote and appointment directly; a displayed request does not confirm availability. Public visitor office not established.

providers.name: Ana's Mobile Dog Grooming
providers.description: Riverbank-based mobile dog groomer whose FAQ names Lathrop and Manteca. It excludes new clients in Mountain House and Tracy, does not serve apartment complexes, requires two street-parking spaces and lists a 60-pound dog limit. Confirm address eligibility, dog requirements, quote and current appointment availability directly.

rebrand_update.name: iLuvMyPack Mobile Grooming (formerly Bayberry Grooming)
rebrand_update.description: The official iLuvMyPack site identifies its former name as Bayberry Grooming and explicitly lists Mountain House, Tracy, Lathrop and Manteca for mobile dog grooming. It offers new-client intake with availability dependent on existing routes. Confirm address eligibility, dog needs, quote and appointments directly; public phone and visitor office not established.
